contexts.text: Bethuel, etc. () = various religiosities and worships.
Bethuel begat Rebekah () from good their affection of truth.

Father, here, namely Bethuel = the good of charity such as it is with the more upright gentiles, for the very origin of the affection of truth which Rebekah represents was from such good. AC 3115. AC 3160. AC 3665, Explained.
The reason Bethuel is here surnamed the Aramean () is that by Aram or Syria are signified Knowledges of good and truth.
